card.name: Digits and decimal points in numbers
card.fires_on: Numbers being written out: a first digit or decimal point inside a figure, such as a dose, section number, or measurement, often just before the next digit.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a number right before a unit or the rest of the figure, such as a strength or count.

modes.label: Decimal point in section numbers
modes.description: The period inside a cross-reference or section number like 12.3 or 5.1.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space or number word right before a numeral or a number such as 47 or ten.

card.plain: It fires while a number is being written, at the first digit or the decimal point, before the rest of the figure appears.
